tokenName: Securities Exchange Community Grain Receipt Token
underlyingAsset: Certified community grain and produce deposits — Malawi
description: Securities Exchange lists tokenised warehouse receipts from smallholder farmers and rural cooperatives in Malawi. Any farmer with certified stored produce can list their receipt on this exchange, attracting institutional buyers and creating immediate liquidity for rural communities. Minimum lot size is 1 bag of produce.
regulatoryFramework: Malawi Warehouse Receipts Act; Securities Exchange Commodity Listing Rules

tokenName: Securities Exchange Digital Service Contract Token
underlyingAsset: Tokenised gig and informal service contracts — Malawi
description: Service workers, artisans, freelancers and gig economy participants in Malawi can tokenise their service contracts on Securities Exchange. Each token represents a verified contract, enabling service workers to attract working capital financing from investors. Electricians, tailors, plumbers and IT contractors all benefit from this financial inclusion instrument.
regulatoryFramework: Malawi Financial Markets Act; Malawi Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Securities Exchange Public Works Employment Token
description: Listed on Securities Exchange, this PPP contract token finances public infrastructure in Malawi — roads, schools, hospitals and clean water. The project commits to local hiring quotas, ensuring 60%+ of construction jobs go to citizens in surrounding communities. Token holders receive revenue-sharing distributions while simultaneously supporting national employment creation.
regulatoryFramework: Malawi PPP Act; Public Works Employment Tokenisation Policy

description: Anyone in Malawi with as little as one unit of local currency can co-own affordable housing through Securities Exchange. The token represents fractional equity in social and affordable housing developments. Rental income is distributed to all token holders, enabling ordinary workers and students to build real estate wealth for the first time.
regulatoryFramework: Malawi Financial Markets Act; Malawi Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Securities Exchange Daily Labor Proof Token
description: Street vendors, market traders, casual workers and informal sector participants in Malawi receive a ProofOfWork token each day their verified economic activity is recorded via mobile phone. Token holders build a verifiable work history that attracts microloans, insurance, and investment. Securities Exchange lists these tokens so impact investors can directly fund the informal economy.
regulatoryFramework: Malawi Labour Act; Informal Economy Tokenisation Framework 2024

underlyingAsset: Verified construction and project milestones — Malawi
description: Construction crews, artisan cooperatives, and community contractors in Malawi earn milestone tokens when independent inspectors verify completed project stages. Securities Exchange lists these milestone tokens, allowing impact investors to fund the next stage while workers receive immediate payment for verified work. Reduces unemployment in the construction sector by guaranteeing staged funding.
regulatoryFramework: Malawi Financial Markets Act; Malawi Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

description: Smallholder farmers across Malawi access crop financing through tokens listed on Securities Exchange. Each token represents verified seasonal crop credit extended to registered farmers. Investors earn returns from harvest proceeds while farmers gain pre-season capital to buy seeds, fertiliser and equipment — breaking the poverty cycle in rural communities.
regulatoryFramework: Malawi Agriculture Finance Act; Capital Markets Agricultural Token Rules

underlyingAsset: Micro and small enterprise investment — Malawi
description: Market stall operators, street vendors, home-based producers and micro-enterprises in Malawi list their businesses as investable tokens on Securities Exchange. Ordinary people become investors in their neighbours' businesses. Token holders receive profit distributions from the SME pool. Minimum investment is the price of one cup of tea — true financial inclusion.
regulatoryFramework: Malawi Financial Markets Act; Malawi Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Securities Exchange All-Inclusive Market ETF Token
underlyingAsset: Broad market ETF accessible to all investors — Malawi
description: This ETF token on Securities Exchange pools capital from all income levels — from a domestic worker saving monthly wages to a pension fund — into a single diversified portfolio. Tracking the full Malawi market including SMEs, REITs, bonds and commodity tokens. Minimum investment is one token. Automated rebalancing ensures optimal exposure across all 15 asset token categories.
regulatoryFramework: Malawi Financial Markets Act; Malawi Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

description: Any citizen of Malawi with a mobile phone and a DID-verified digital wallet can buy fractional shares in any company listed on Securities Exchange via this digital equity token. Previously only available to wealthy investors and institutions, listed equity is now accessible from as little as one unit of local currency. Promotes broad-based wealth creation.
regulatoryFramework: Malawi Financial Markets Act; Malawi Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Securities Exchange Retail Government Bond Token
underlyingAsset: Fractional government bond for retail investors — Malawi
description: Government bonds in Malawi, formerly requiring minimum investments of thousands, are now accessible via Securities Exchange from as little as one currency unit. Every salary earner, market vendor and smallholder farmer can invest their savings in sovereign fixed-income instruments and earn consistent returns previously reserved for banks and large institutions.
regulatoryFramework: Malawi Financial Markets Act; Malawi Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Securities Exchange Financial Inclusion Universal Token
description: The Securities Exchange Financial Inclusion token bridges formal and informal economies in Malawi. It represents a basket of community micro-investments — market women's cooperatives, youth enterprise groups, disability enterprise clusters, and informal savings groups (chamas/susus). No minimum investment. Designed to give every adult a stake in the national economy.
regulatoryFramework: Malawi Financial Inclusion Strategy; National Digital Economy Policy 2024

tokenName: Securities Exchange Artisanal Mining Community Token
underlyingAsset: Artisanal and small-scale mining output — Malawi
description: Artisanal and small-scale miners (ASM) in Malawi tokenise their verified mineral output through Securities Exchange. Copper, gold, cobalt, lithium and other critical minerals mined by community cooperatives attract institutional and retail investment. Miners receive fair market prices immediately while investors gain exposure to commodity markets. Reduces exploitation of artisanal miners.
regulatoryFramework: Malawi Mines and Minerals Act; Artisanal Mining Tokenisation Policy

tokenName: Securities Exchange Smallholder Harvest Verification Token
description: Smallholder farmers in Malawi earn AgriPoW tokens when satellite imagery, IoT soil sensors and field agents verify their planting, growing and harvest activities. Securities Exchange lists these tokens, allowing impact investors and agri-funds to directly reward verified agricultural output. Farmers build a verifiable credit history that unlocks loans, insurance and investment — without traditional collateral requirements.
regulatoryFramework: Malawi Agriculture Act; Digital Agriculture Proof-of-Work Standards

tokenName: Securities Exchange Community Supply Chain Token
underlyingAsset: End-to-end community supply chain tracking — Malawi
description: From the smallholder farm gate to the urban market stall, Securities Exchange issues supply chain tokens at every verified step. Market women, transporters, processors, and retailers all earn tokens for their verified role in the supply chain. Investors gain transparent exposure to the real economy. Supply chain financing reduces post-harvest losses and creates stable employment.
regulatoryFramework: Malawi Trade Act; National Supply Chain Tokenisation Framework
